description: Reads the project to find every sound effect it needs and produces a checklist: what exists, what is missing, what is placeholder. Produces a list, never the audio.
when_to_use: the request is 'what sound effects do we still need'
an SFX generation run needs a list to work from
avoid_when: the list already exists and the request is to produce the sounds
the audio in question is music rather than effects
inputs: the sfx bible when there is one
